Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
characterization

Compare washed and unwashed 7 nm core emission; assess diluted slide visibility

Compare the separate 7 nm core-only control before and after washing, and assess diluted samples on glass. The reported unwashed QY and emission wavelength are outcomes, not washing settings. Its upstream core synthesis is unreported. Missing fields: core synthesis, exact washing/deposition.

No separate quantity entered here; consult stocks, operations and source notes below.

source claimA 7 nm CdSe core-only sample has about 15% ensemble QY at 680 nm before washing.
